div.head: Hn mon 3
div.ab: Praeterea defendo, ne aliquis monetarius denarios mutet, nisi in comitatu suo et hoc coram duobus legittimis testibus de ipso comitatu.
In addition, I forbid any moneyer to recast money, except in his own county and in the presence of two lawful witnesses from the same county.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 284–285 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added
